what_it_is.text: Gwanghwamun is the main south gate of Gyeongbokgung Palace — the palace's front door.

why_it_matters.text: As the main gate, it is bigger and fancier than the palace's other gates.

what_to_look_for.text: Count the three arched openings: the middle one was for the king, the side ones for the crown prince and officials.

fun_fact.text: After restoration work, the gate reopened to the public on August 15, 2010.

visit_note.text: Passing through the gate and entering the palace may follow different rules; check on the day.
